title: Domain Pack: B2B SaaS / RBAC
summary: B2B SaaS role-based access control domain-specific test considerations for workspace, organization, membership, permission, role, invitation, audit log, admin settings. Role dimensions: owner, admin, editor, viewer, billing admin, suspended user, invited user, external guest. Risk hotspots: unauthorized privilege escalation, last owner removal/downgrade, stale permission after role change, invitation treated as active membership, audit log gaps, billing/security settings exposure, cross-tenant data access.
